claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped: The star said he was not responsible for Macklemore being dropped from the line-up after he made pro-Palestinian statements on stage.
- Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter: The Danish prime minister has accused Russia of "reckless" behaviour, while the Kremlin is yet to comment.
- What weapon could the US have put into space?: The announcement by the US points to a developing field of modern warfare in the Earth's orbit.
- South African president vows justice as more women's bodies found near Johannesburg: Police have not linked the deaths to a serial killer but are investigating this possibility.
- Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says: Iran says El Gaia caught fire after hitting mines, but the US says the oil tanker was struck by a missile and then a drone.
- Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".
- Suspected sabotage causes major Netherlands rail disruption: Trains were cancelled or delayed on Tuesday after objects were found on tracks at multiple locations.
- Five takeaways from Canada's push to woo the world's richest investors: A $1tn sales pitch, more than 160 projects on offer, pivot to the EU amid a bitter trade war with the US - takeaways from the first Canada Investment Summit.
- Nigeria arrests alleged Mexican drug kingpin at international airport: Arturo Carrera Loaiza denies allegations he was involved in meth production, the Nigerian authorities say.
- Ash from Mount Etna grounds flights at Sicily airport: All flights are suspended from one of Italy's busiest airports until Tuesday night.
- More than 100,000 people in Japan are now aged 100 or older: Figures show 88% of the centenarians are women as the population continues to age and shrink.
- British woman abducted in Malawi, police say: The mother of two young children was kidnapped in the middle of the day in the main city, Blantyre.
